publisher: Latvia Ministry of Smart Administration and Regional Development (VARAM)
underlyingSource: State Land Service State Address Register geospatial data
processing: Shared-boundary simplification at 150 m in EPSG:3059; transform to WGS84 with pyproj; fit only external coastline/international-outline differences to the existing Natural Earth outline; apply common world topology and screen LOD generation. Varaklani is already merged into Madona in the official source.
